name: At Schhol II.
description: Vocabulary for situations at school, in class, during school activities, and in interpersonal relationships.
author: Robert Dikacz, 2026

words.definition: An exam that you must take to be allowed to enter a school, university, or other institution.
words.example_en: She passed the entrance examination and was accepted to the university.
words.example_sk: Urobila prijímaciu skúšku a prijali ju na univerzitu.

words.definition: A school that is not run by the government and is usually paid for by students' families.
words.example_en: Their children go to a private school in the city.
words.example_sk: Ich deti chodia do súkromnej školy v meste.

words.definition: The money paid for teaching or instruction, especially at a school, college, or university.
words.example_en: University tuition has increased over the past few years.
words.example_sk: Školné na univerzite sa za posledných pár rokov zvýšilo.

words.translation: gymnázium; výberová verejná škola so zameraním
words.definition: A grammar school is a secondary school, especially in the UK, that traditionally emphasizes academic subjects and may select students based on ability. A magnet school is a public school, especially in the US, with a special focus or program designed to attract students from different areas.
words.example_en: She passed the exam and got into a grammar school, while her cousin attends a magnet school focused on science.
words.example_sk: Urobila prijímaciu skúšku a dostala sa na gymnázium, zatiaľ čo jej bratranec navštevuje výberovú verejnú školu zameranú na prírodné vedy.

words.definition: The subjects and content taught in a school, course, or program of study.
words.example_en: The school updated its curriculum to include more digital skills.
words.example_sk: Škola aktualizovala svoje učebné osnovy tak, aby zahŕňali viac digitálnych zručností.

words.definition: Education that children are legally required to receive.
words.example_en: Compulsory education begins at the age of six in many countries.
words.example_sk: Povinná školská dochádzka sa v mnohých krajinách začína vo veku šiestich rokov.

words.definition: An examination given in the middle of an academic term, or the middle period of a term or course.
words.example_en: I have a math midterm next week.
words.example_sk: Budúci týždeň mám priebežnú skúšku z matematiky.

words.definition: Tests or examinations given in the middle of an academic term.
words.example_en: Students are studying hard for their midterm exams.
words.example_sk: Študenti sa usilovne učia na priebežné skúšky.

words.definition: The act of officially registering for something, especially a course, school, or program; also the number of people registered.
words.example_en: Student enrollment increased significantly this year.
words.example_sk: Počet zapísaných študentov sa tento rok výrazne zvýšil.

words.definition: A school that teaches practical skills and training for a specific job or trade.
words.example_en: He decided to attend a vocational school to become an electrician.
words.example_sk: Rozhodol sa navštevovať odbornú školu, aby sa stal elektrikárom.

words.definition: Final exams taken at the end of secondary school, often required for graduation or university admission.
words.example_en: She is studying hard for her school leaving exams.
words.example_sk: Usilovne sa učí na maturitné skúšky.

words.definition: A piece of work or task that is given to someone, especially as part of their studies or job.
words.example_en: I need to finish my assignment by Friday.
words.example_sk: Musím dokončiť svoje zadanie do piatka.

words.definition: A planned piece of work with a specific aim, or to throw, calculate, or present something forward.
words.example_en: Our group finished the science project on time.
words.example_sk: Naša skupina dokončila vedecký projekt načas.

words.definition: School work that students are given to do at home.
words.example_en: I finished my homework after dinner.
words.example_sk: Po večeri som dokončil svoju domácu úlohu.

words.definition: A way of teaching and learning that takes place outside, often involving direct experience of nature or practical activities.
words.example_en: Outdoor education helps students learn through real experiences in nature.
words.example_sk: Outdoorové vzdelávanie pomáha študentom učiť sa prostredníctvom skutočných skúseností v prírode.

words.definition: A trip made by students or a group to a place outside the classroom to learn about something directly.
words.example_en: Our class went on a field trip to the science museum.
words.example_sk: Naša trieda išla na školský výlet do vedeckého múzea.

words.definition: An organization at a school made up of parents and teachers that works to support students and school activities.
words.example_en: The PTA is organizing a fundraiser for new library books.
words.example_sk: Združenie rodičov a učiteľov organizuje zbierku na nové knihy do knižnice.

words.definition: Activities that students do outside their regular school classes, such as sports, clubs, or music.
words.example_en: She joined several extracurricular activities, including drama club and volleyball.
words.example_sk: Zapojila sa do viacerých mimoškolských aktivít vrátane dramatického krúžku a volejbalu.

words.definition: The study of numbers, shapes, patterns, and the relationships between them.
words.example_en: Mathematics is my favorite subject at school.
words.example_sk: Matematika je môj obľúbený predmet v škole.

words.definition: The branch of science that studies matter, energy, motion, and forces.
words.example_en: She studies physics at university.
words.example_sk: Študuje fyziku na univerzite.

words.definition: The scientific study of substances, their properties, structure, and the changes they undergo.
words.example_en: She studies chemistry at university.
words.example_sk: Študuje chémiu na univerzite.

words.definition: A school subject in which students do physical exercise and sports.
words.example_en: We have PE twice a week at school.
words.example_sk: V škole máme telesnú výchovu dvakrát do týždňa.

words.definition: School subjects and activities related to reading, writing, speaking, listening, and literature.
words.example_en: Language arts helps students improve their reading and writing skills.
words.example_sk: Jazykové umenie pomáha študentom zlepšovať ich čitateľské a písomné zručnosti.

words.definition: A question or exercise in mathematics that requires calculation, reasoning, or proof.
words.example_en: I spent an hour trying to solve the math problem.
words.example_sk: Strávil som hodinu snahou vyriešiť matematickú úlohu.

words.definition: The branch of mathematics that deals with shapes, sizes, lines, angles, and the properties of space.
words.example_en: We study geometry to learn about triangles, circles, and angles.
words.example_sk: Študujeme geometriu, aby sme sa naučili o trojuholníkoch, kruhoch a uhloch.

words.definition: The scientific study of living organisms and life processes.
words.example_en: She studies biology at university.
words.example_sk: Študuje biológiu na univerzite.

words.definition: The study of style in language, especially in literary and spoken texts.
words.example_en: She is studying stylistics to better understand how authors use language.
words.example_sk: Študuje štylistiku, aby lepšie pochopila, ako autori používajú jazyk.

words.definition: A school subject that studies history, geography, civics, and society.
words.example_en: My favorite subject at school is social studies.
words.example_sk: Môj obľúbený predmet v škole sú spoločenské vedy.

words.definition: A laboratory; a room or building used for scientific experiments, research, or testing.
words.example_en: The students are doing an experiment in the lab.
words.example_sk: Študenti robia experiment v laboratóriu.

words.definition: A building or room used for sports, exercise, and physical education; in some contexts, a type of secondary school.
words.example_en: The students gathered in the gymnasium for the basketball game.
words.example_sk: Študenti sa zhromaždili v telocvični na basketbalový zápas.

words.definition: To be required to stay at school for a period of time as a punishment.
words.example_en: He had a detention for talking during the lesson.
words.example_sk: Dostal školský trest za rozprávanie počas hodiny.

words.definition: To be officially forced to leave a school, organization, or country.
words.example_en: He was expelled from school for breaking the rules.
words.example_sk: Bol vylúčený zo školy za porušenie pravidiel.
